interface.longDescription:
Share project files, AI-generated work, and project context with your team and Codex in one workspace. Find existing work, review recorded decisions and supporting materials, and build on work shared by teammates or created with AI—with less time spent transferring files and explaining project history.

Explore saved project context and relationships between files to understand how work developed and which materials it relies on. Stay informed through Firmory’s related-update notifications when referenced materials change, and check whether your documents, code, or other deliverables need updating.
defaultPrompt: Show me the projects and files available in my workspace
Find the project brief and summarize its goals and key decisions
Open "Welcome.pdf" and summarize its key points
